_comment: Epic layout for plan.mjs. Each ticket takes the open features of one atlas domain that match its selector, in order; '*' takes what is left of the domain. Selectors: '*', { "idPattern": "^(regex on the id after <app>.<domain>.)" }, or { "menuRoot": "Filter", "menuCategory": ["Blur", "Sharpen"] } (groups an item and its _option records by menu path). This example is the Photoshop round of October 2026. An id selector looks like { "idPattern": "^tfo" } (InDesign text frame options: ids like indesign.text_frames.tfo_general_columns).
